handoffs.whatMoves: Notification that the applicant submitted an application
Supervisor recommendation, acknowledgement that the person is applying, and expected support for classwork and project time
handoffs.how: Supervisor completes additional steps after receiving the KualiBuild notification

handoffs.whatMoves: Direction to set up a student account and register for the class term
handoffs.how: Awardees are directed to the DES program manager after notification

handoffs.whatMoves: Final presentation and related project details
handoffs.how: Awardees send them to OSI after delivering the final presentation

decisions.decision: Move the project task into project accepted
decisions.basis: The process does not require an MOU like other processes

decisions.decision: Review applicants and score their submissions
decisions.decidesOn: Whether submissions fit the expectations of the class
decisions.basis: A rubric comparing different requirements and an evaluation guide

decisions.decision: Determine how many scholarships can be awarded
decisions.decidesOn: The number of awards the program is able to provide and the overall set of applicants
decisions.basis: Available awards, representation from different VC areas and campus portions, different project types, and avoiding awards focused on the same problems

decisions.decision: Give a recommendation on the application
decisions.decidesOn: The applicant's application and the supervisor's awareness and ability to support class and project time
